Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
Ok...

Renewed vigor says (among others): restore an ally or retainer to his or
hers starting life (with counters from the bloodbank)

If I play this card on an ally with more life than her starting value (say,
Succubus), does the succubus lose surplus life, or does the word "restore"
by definition forbid removing blood? Also, is it legal to play this card on
an ally with it's starting amount of life?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It will not reduce the ally's life.
Yes.
